Preserve the existing redaction, latency/count, stable-code and degradation behavior.

review_fix_audit.evidence: All six temporal fields are normalized to timezone-aware UTC ISO-8601 before write. EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE uses exact null-safe CASE WHEN parameter IS NULL THEN null ELSE datetime(parameter) END conversion for published_at, retrieved_at, filed_at, effective_from, effective_to and materialized_at. Invalid required time fails closed and no current-time substitution exists.

Legacy aggregate MERGE is reachable only for write_mode=legacy plus provenance=legacy_explicit. Temporal, V2-origin, unknown-provenance and quarantined inputs are prepared before any entity/relation write; incomplete or invalid records are skipped with a compact rejected count and stable allowlisted rejection code. Focused counterexamples assert zero write calls.

The canonical Stage 03 materialized_at/ingested_at provenance is carried into GraphDocument without a now fallback, required for temporal V2, normalized once and persisted as a Neo4j DateTime on EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE only. Deterministic retry tests prove the same evidence identity retains the same materialized_at and no ON MATCH overwrite exists.

preserved_observability_findings.evidence: All three retriever decorators still use compact process_inputs/process_outputs. Sentinel tests prove query text, raw evidence/chunk payloads, URLs, titles, secrets and raw error text are absent. The allowlist remains bounded, but its attempt field is stale.

Vector, Graph, RRF/fusion and Hybrid boundaries expose non-negative measured latency, compact result/evidence/citation counts, branch availability, deterministic degradation mode/flags and stateless resume. Graph extraction/upsert exposes compact latency, document/entity/relation/skipped/rejected/failure counts and caller-retry recovery. Attempt attribution is stale only in Hybrid retrieval telemetry.

Retrieval, Graph extraction and Graph upsert failures return/log/capture only stable sanitized codes. No original exception object/message, raw evidence, private source URL, provider payload, prompt, token or credential reaches result, log, trace processor or Sentry capture.
